history.prompt:
Create an original publication-quality technical explanatory illustration as a no-text PNG. The supplied external images are mechanism references only: independently design a fresh composition, never imitate their layout or typography. Use a pure white canvas (transparent is acceptable only if it composites as pure white), thin muted graphite flow arrows, flat 2D orthographic shapes, smooth solid pale fills. Palette: cyan input (#4DBBD5), green processing (#00A087), warm orange pooling (#F39B7F), muted blue representations (#3C5488), red output/gradients (#E64B35), neutral gray supporting parts. Colors at low opacity for large areas, stronger outlines and small accents. Balance white modules with selectively pale colored groups, one dominant color per semantic group. Same semantic modules share treatment; adjacent unlike semantics have different color. No glossy icon tiles, no card dashboard, no thick title bars, no decorative 3D, no perspective side faces, no extruded tensors, no shadow, glow, blur, gradient, texture, paper grain, noise, ripple, stripe or watermark. Mechanism marks (flat grids, feature-map thumbnails, small nodes, pooling cells) must carry scientific information rather than decorative icons. Optional decorative icons at most one per group; preferably none for operator diagrams. Avoid excessive boxes around everything. Reserve generous blank title and adjacent numeric annotation areas for later real-font typesetting. ABSOLUTELY NO readable text, letters, digits, equations, operation symbols, pseudo-glyphs, placeholder scribbles or watermark. All labels and math will be added later. A handwritten specimen inside an input image is an allowed visual sample, not a printed label. Arrowheads are required at actual destinations, no disconnected stubs or unexplained edges.

Scientific brief:
Explain simplified GoogLeNet MAIN CLASSIFICATION PATH with rich tiny Inception branch schematics. Input image → convolution/pooling stem → TWO Inception modules → pooling → FIVE Inception modules → pooling → TWO Inception modules → global average pooling → classifier. Exact count 2/5/2 must be drawn as grouped repeated miniature four-branch modules, each visibly has four inner routes merging by channel concatenation; repeated stage can use explicit repeated motifs and blank count label spaces, not arbitrary fake ellipsis. Stem can be a compact filter/grid transformation, final global average pooling a whole-map reduction to channel vector. No auxiliary head depicted as an independent main prediction. Large blank stage titles and shape labels below, conv green, pool pale orange, channel representations blue, output red. White dominates, no giant enclosing stage cards.

Revise this new GoogLeNet draft. Preserve top main count TWO/FIVE/TWO Inception groups and pool placements, global average pool, classifier. Flatten EVERY angled feature slab and cube to a frontal flat rectangular thumbnail or channel strip, no diagonal side faces, extrusion, perspective. Exact enlarged inset four paths: path1 SINGLE 1x1 kernel cell; path2 1x1 reduction cell then3x3 grid; path3 1x1 reduction cell then5x5 grid; path4 3x3 max-pool grid then1x1 cell; join all four at channel concat. Avoid painting four paths as arbitrary serial operators. Equal output map spatial sizes. Leave ample blank label space above stage groups, under shapes and inside enlarged inset. No text/digits/formulas, flat pure white with smooth very pale solids.

source_audit.caption: 经典GoogLeNet的主分类路径。卷积前端把$224\times224$输入变成$28\times28\times192$；两个、五个、两个Inception模块组成三个阶段，阶段间池化改变空间尺度。各阶段末的通道数为480、832和1024，全局平均池化后接1000类分类器。辅助分类分支及模块内部细节省略，模块内部结构见图~\ref{fig:cnn-inception}。
